understand.title: Understand the Request
understand.instruction: Analyze the Python project's development request before proposing an implementation. The toolchain-sync operation installs the pinned environment on session start (optional; failure does not block).

plan.title: Create the Implementation Plan
plan.instruction: Create a concrete implementation plan with stable task identifiers, affected files, dependencies, planned tests, and verification.

review_and_adjust_plan.title: Review and Adjust the Plan
review_and_adjust_plan.instruction: Review the plan critically before implementation; submit findings and the adjusted plan.

implement.title: Implement the Approved Plan
implement.instruction: Implement the approved plan; verification runs ruff, pytest and mypy via the pinned uv environment.

review_and_fix_implementation.title: Review and Fix the Implementation
review_and_fix_implementation.instruction: Review the implementation against the plan; fix findings before verification.

verify.title: Verify the Implementation
verify.instruction: The verify phase runs lint (ruff), test (pytest) and check (mypy) as required operations via uv run --locked; completion requires all of them to succeed.

complete.title: Complete the Feature
complete.instruction: Summarize the completed work and submit the completion report.
